Measure success rate and hang/timeout rate per trial, communicator-init and collective latency in ms, message size in bytes, bandwidth in GB/s, GPU/NIC utilization, link errors, retransmits, queue depth, and cleanup duration in seconds. Report n, median and p95/p99 where applicable, units, confidence intervals or uncertainty, baseline and no-change controls, and correctness checks. Do not claim improvement from one run or from a changed timeout.

Operate read-only first with least privilege and an approved maintenance window. Do not disable firewall controls, expose services, or change cluster-wide settings. A bounded canary may change one scoped setting with an owner, pre-change snapshot, abort threshold, and rollback command. Roll back immediately if any control job fails, error counters rise, correctness differs, the hang spreads, or the canary exceeds the agreed timeout; restore the prior mapping/configuration, terminate descendants safely, verify cleanup, and preserve redacted logs. Evidence required includes per-rank/backend logs, inventory and configuration, authorized reachability and policy checks, topology/NIC/GPU counters, repeated matched trials, and domain-owner review. Until those data agree, label the cause unknown.
